name: Pictogram Protocol
description: Stark safety-sign pictogram art for survival-rule and creepy-protocol videos: solid black silhouette figures with round heads and no face, flat white backgrounds or pure black rooms, heavy outlines and one alarm colour — signal red (plus warning yellow). Bold condensed headline stamps slam onto the key spoken word (DON'T MOVE, CHECK THE DATE), numbered RULE cards, red arrows and circles, warning triangles, 2:00 AM clock stamps, flickering lights, flashlight cones, hard cuts and an uncanny visitor whose eyes show in the dark.
fonts: Impact, Haettenschweiler, "Arial Narrow Bold", "Franklin Gothic Demi Cond", Oswald, "Roboto Condensed", "Liberation Sans Narrow", "Arial Narrow", "Arial Black", "Noto Sans", sans-serif
